## Intelligent Octopus EV guard
When Octopus schedules an **extra** EV charge outside the normal off-peak window, the house battery would otherwise discharge into the car at peak-time rates. This turns on grid charge on ONE timer slot for that window (holding the battery), then puts the slot back.
**Dry run is ON by default** (`GUARD_DRY_RUN`). Writes also need `SUNSYNK_WRITES_ENABLED=true` on Sunsynk Control.
Works with any IO-supported EV or charger. The plug-in gate is optional.
